dedupe_keys.name: seismic and liquefaction hazard study for five western tennessee counties

description: Seismic and Liquefaction Hazard Study for Five Western Tennessee Counties is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Chris Cramer, University of Memphis (memphis.edu). Seismic and liquefaction study of five western Tennessee counties provides uniquely detailed hazard that includes the effects of local geology. County reports are made available to county officials, consultants, and other researchers. MASW Vs profiles measured during the project can be reused in compilations/studies and are made available to researchers and consultants. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-y1xv-6x87. Keywords: Tennessee County reports, MASW Vs profiles by project year, gridded geology and Vs reference files, seismic and liquefaction hazard maps and data. Published 2023-06-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
